If the request body content type is text, the function converts the body content into UTF-8 and returns a string. Otherwise, the function returns a datablock.

webapp.name: GetHTTPField
webapp.doc: This function retrieves the name HTTP request field. The following fields are supported: Authorization, Referer, Destination, Cookie, User-Agent, Host. If the name value is an empty string, the HTTP request URL (without the optional URL parameters) is returned. If the name value is the Schema string, the request URL schema used (the http or https string) is returned.

webapp.name: GetHTTPParameter
webapp.doc: This function retrieves an HTTP request parameter. HTTP request parameters include URL parameters and/or form fields. The name value should be a string specifying the HTTP request parameter name. An HTTP request can contain several parameters with the same name.

webapp.name: GetHTTPQuery
webapp.doc: This function retrieves the parameter string from the HTTP request URL. If the request URL does not contain parameters, the function return a null-value.

webapp.name: GetHTTPResource
webapp.doc: This function retrieves the HTTP request query string, including all URL parameters.

webapp.name: GetHTTPSubtype
webapp.doc: This function retrieves the HTTP request body Content subtype.

webapp.name: GetHTTPType
webapp.doc: This function retrieves the HTTP request body Content type.

webapp.name: ProcessWSSP
webapp.doc: This procedure composes the HTTP response body using the specified WSSP page and the result dataset. The pageName value should be a string with the page name (without the wssp suffix). This page is retrieved from the currently selected Skin. The resultSet value should be a dictionary.

webapp.name: ProxiedIPAddress
webapp.doc: If the HTTP request was relayed by some external HTTP proxy, this function returns the original client IP Address. Otherwise the function returns a null-object.

webapp.name: RemoteIPAddress
webapp.doc: This function returns an ip-address object specifying the IP Address the HTTP request was received from.

webapp.name: SendHTTPContinue
webapp.doc: This function sends the 100-Continue HTTP response. If the response is successfully sent, the function returns a null-value, otherwise it returns an error code string.

webapp.name: SessionData
webapp.doc: This function returns the Session Dataset dictionary.

webapp.name: SetHTTPResponseCode
webapp.doc: This procedure sets the HTTP response code. 999 range or a string. If the string starts with a 3-digit prefix and the - symbol, then the prefix specifies the HTTP response code, and the rest of the string specifies the HTTP response text. If there is no such prefix in the code string value, then the HTTP response code is set to 500, and the entire string is used as the HTTP response text.

webapp.name: SetHTTPResponseData
webapp.doc: This procedure sets the HTTP response body. The data value should be either a string, a datablock, a dictionary, or an XML object.

webapp.name: SetHTTPResponseType
webapp.doc: This procedure sets the HTTP response Content-Type field values. The mimeType and subtype values should be strings containing valid MIME atoms.

wssp.name: ACCOUNTSETTINGS
wssp.doc: This function can be used only in Session-based requests. The function value is the effective Account setting value associated with the string key. The key parameter can be specified as an alphanumeric string, or as a quoted string.

wssp.name: ARRAY
wssp.doc: The value of this function is the object associated with the key in the Skin Text Dataset. This object should be an array, otherwise the function returns a null-value. The key can be specified either as a quoted string literal, or as an expression - the expression value is calculated and used as the key.

wssp.name: BOOLARRAY
wssp.doc: The value is a 2-element array, containing the strings "NO" and "YES".

wssp.name: CHECKED
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its boolean value is calculated, and if its positive (true), the function returns the string "checked", otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: CONTAINS
wssp.doc: The function returns the string "YES" if the value of the array parameter is an array, and the string is equal to one of the array elements. Otherwise the function returns a null-value. The string can be specified either as a quoted string literal, or as an expression.

wssp.name: CURRENTTIME
wssp.doc: This function value is a timestamp - the current global time.

wssp.name: DICTIONARY
wssp.doc: The value of this function is the object associated with the key in the Skin Text Dataset. This object should be a dictionary, otherwise the function returns a null-value. The key can be specified either as a quoted string literal, or as an expression - the expression value is calculated and used as the key.

wssp.name: DOESNOTEXIST
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "NO" if the calculated value is not a null-value, or the string "YES" if the returned value is a null-value.

wssp.name: EMPTYARRAY
wssp.doc: The value of this function is an array with zero elements.

wssp.name: EMPTYDICTIONARY
wssp.doc: The value of this function is an empty dictionary.

wssp.name: EMPTYSTRING
wssp.doc: The value of this function is an empty string.

wssp.name: EQUALS
wssp.doc: Both expressions are calculated, and if the calculated values match (including the case when both expressions return a null-value), the function returns the string "YES". Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: EQUALSNOCASE
wssp.doc: Both expressions are calculated. The function returns the string "YES" if both calculated values are a null-value or if both values are strings and these strings match using the ASCII case-insensitive comparison operation. In all other cases the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: EXISTS
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is not a null-value, or the string "NO" if the returned value is a null-value.

wssp.name: HASPARENTMAILBOX
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is a string, representing a name of hierarchical Mailbox. Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: INCLUDEARG
wssp.doc: This function can be used only inside an include file. The key should be a decimal number specifying the parameter number of the <!--%%INCLUDE--> element that invoked this include file. The first parameter has the number 0. If the <!--%%INCLUDE--> element did not specify enough parameters, the function value is a null-value.

wssp.name: ISARRAY
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is an array. Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISDATA
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is a datablock object. Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISDATE
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is a timestamp. Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISDICTIONARY
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is a dictionary. Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISEVEN
wssp.doc: --> construct surrounding the current portion of the script code. If the current value of the index is even, the function returns the string "YES". Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISFIRST
wssp.doc: --> construct surrounding the current portion of the script code. If the current value of the array index is zero, the function returns the string "YES". Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISHALF
wssp.doc: --> construct surrounding the current portion of the script code. If the current value of the index is equal to the number of array or dictionary elements divided by 2, the function returns the string "YES". Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISINDEX
wssp.doc: --> construct surrounding the current portion of the script code. The expression value is calculated, and if its numeric value matches the current index in the array this scanner is used for, the function returns the string "YES". Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISLAST
wssp.doc: --> construct surrounding the current portion of the script code. If the current value of the array index is equal to the number of array or dictionary elements minus one, the function returns the string "YES". Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISNUMBER
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is a number. Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: ISSTRING
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its value is calculated, and the function returns the string "YES" if the calculated value is a string. Otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: KNOWNTIMEZONES
wssp.doc: The function returns a fixed array with string elements - names of time zones known to the system ("NorthAmerica/Pacific","Europe/Central","(+0900) Japan/Korea", ...)

wssp.name: MONTHNAMES
wssp.doc: The function returns a fixed array with 12 string elements: ("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec") . - WEEKDAYS() and WEEKDAYS(expression) If expression is not specified, the function returns a fixed array with 7 string elements: (Sun,Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri,Sat).

wssp.name: NOT
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its boolean value is calculated, and the function returns a null-value if the value is positive (true), otherwise the function returns the string "YES".

wssp.name: NULL
wssp.doc: The value of this function is a null-value.

wssp.name: RANDOMELEMENT
wssp.doc: The array parameter is an expression that should return an array value; The value of this function is a randomly-selected element from that array.

wssp.name: REQUESTRESOURCE
wssp.doc: The function returns the resource string (the local part of the URL with optional URL parameters) of the current HTTP request.

wssp.name: REQUESTSECURE
wssp.doc: e. is sent via the HTTPS protocol), otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: REQUESTSOURCEIP
wssp.doc: The function returns the string with the IP Network Address the HTTP request originated from.

wssp.name: REQUIRED
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its boolean value is calculated, and if its positive (true), the function returns the string "required", otherwise the function returns a null-value.

wssp.name: SELECTEDLANGUAGE
wssp.doc: This function value is a string - the currently selected language name.

wssp.name: SELECTEDTIMEZONE
wssp.doc: This function value is a string - the currently selected time zone name.

wssp.name: SERVERVERSION
wssp.doc: The function returns the string with the current CommuniGate Pro Server version.

wssp.name: SESSION
wssp.doc: This function can be used only in Session-based requests. The function value is the Session Dataset value associated with the string key. The key parameter can be specified as an alphanumeric string, or as a string constant. Example: the SESSION(accountName) expression value is the name of the CommuniGate Pro Account this session is opened for. The Session Dataset is case-insensitive.

wssp.name: SETTINGS
wssp.doc: This function can be used only in Session-based requests. The function value is the effective WebUser setting value associated with the string key. The key parameter can be specified as an alphanumeric string, or as a string constant.

wssp.name: STRING
wssp.doc: The value of this function is the object associated with the key in the Skin Text Dataset. This object should be a string, otherwise the function returns a null-value. The key can be specified either as a quoted string literal, or as an expression - the expression value is calculated and used as the key.

wssp.name: TRANSLATE
wssp.doc: The string parameter is an expression that should return a string value; the dictionary parameter is an expression that should return a dictionary value. If the dictionary contains a string value for the key specified with the first parameter value, the function returns this string.

wssp.name: YESNO
wssp.doc: The parameter is an expression. Its boolean value is calculated, and the value is positive (true), the function returns the string "YES", otherwise it returns the string "NO".
